findings.finding: Registration, membership role, job profile, bearer authentication and MFA foundations exist and are outside the implementation scope.
findings.requiredDelta: Do not change registration code or behavior. Prove the three registration boundary invariants on every later slice.

findings.area: Trusted tenant context and RLS transactions
findings.finding: Canonical modules derive actor and tenant server-side and use scoped PostgreSQL transactions, but legacy and process-local modules bypass the pattern.
findings.requiredDelta: Require RLS transaction context for every new authority and retire bypassing writers.

findings.finding: Specialized repositories atomically bind business rows, audit, outbox and payload fingerprints. Generic AuditService has an in-memory hash head and swallows persistence failures; generic enqueue is not transaction-bound.
findings.requiredDelta: Reuse the specialized transactional repository pattern; never use best-effort audit as business evidence.

findings.finding: The 13-code organization capability registry and PostgreSQL assignment/event authority were merged in #5001 and verified under restricted principals. The effective mode is SHADOW.
findings.requiredDelta: Retain W1-A evidence; prove REG.RU deployment and downstream product consumption without changing registration.
findings.w0Finding: The existing capability resolver describes a person's accounting permissions. There is no durable organization capability registry for the 13 post-registration capabilities.

findings.finding: PostgreSQL Provider, ProviderCapability and ServiceOffering authority replaced the fictional catalog and caller-supplied compliance facts in #5010. Only server-held evidence can admit a provider.
findings.requiredDelta: Prove partner substitution across full service workflows, ranking explanations and REG.RU runtime; no external access or real receipt is inferred.
findings.w0Finding: The API exposes a fictional static pilot catalog, a default Sber entry and an opaque hand-scored ranking. Compliance facts can be supplied by query parameters. The pure fail-closed compliance policy is reusable.

findings.finding: Versioned CommercialRuleSet, RulePack and immutable decisions were merged in #5019. PostgreSQL 11/11, domain 29/29 and API contracts 11/11 passed; database recalculation, complete null-safe references, lifecycle evidence and acknowledgement safety were verified. All 39 workflows succeeded and review threads were resolved.
findings.requiredDelta: Bind server-derived contract/Deal facts and accepted commercial decisions to financial/service workflows and demonstrate the REG.RU runtime. CONTRACT_RULE remains non-financial MISSING_FACTS until authoritative contract facts are available.
findings.w0Finding: There is no versioned CommercialRuleSet or RulePack authority. Existing fee and logistics defaults are ad hoc inputs or environment values and the calculator is not wired to live money.

findings.finding: IntegrationBinding and evidence-backed maturity authority were merged in #5015; unset adapters fail closed. Restricted-principal CI verifies provider suspension and capability revocation. Federal-accounting maturity consumption remains deferred under lock #4321.
findings.requiredDelta: Complete the separately governed consumer handoff and demonstrate provider onboarding, conformance and REG.RU runtime acceptance with authentic external receipts.
findings.w0Finding: Provider-neutral adapter interfaces and honest connection diagnostics exist, but binding state is an in-memory singleton, mocks register by default and there is no per-organization secret/evidence/version/maturity authority.

findings.finding: W1-E Service Marketplace authority merged in #5026; tenant-isolated request/quote/selection/payer/execution/evidence/acceptance lifecycle and append-only non-financial settlement references are PostgreSQL-authoritative. Provider, capability, offering and organization revocation are rechecked. PostgreSQL 12/12 and combined inventory compatibility passed.
findings.requiredDelta: Connect the accepted service lifecycle to existing logistics, lab, document and settlement engines; complete provider onboarding/conformance and user flows, then prove REG.RU execution.
findings.w0Finding: Intake and attestation primitives exist. There is no durable Request to Quote to Selection to PayerConfirmation to Execution to Evidence to Settlement lifecycle or generic conformance kit.

findings.finding: W2-A/#5029 established canonical FORCE-RLS Inventory positions, exact quantity buckets, DECLARE/RESERVE/RELEASE, immutable receipts/snapshots and READ COMMITTED contention. W2-B/#5040 now makes every new Auction registration atomically reserve that canonical stock and persist an immutable lot-to-position/reservation/profile/quantity binding; old verified registration is denied and the bound reservation is protected from legacy release/reuse.
findings.requiredDelta: Make the existing canonical Deal allocate the exact winning quantity from the bound reservation and conserve partial remainder; later bind RFQ/Offer writers, then add complete lifecycle, genealogy, custody/title/restrictions and user-facing acceptance before terminal credit.
findings.w0Finding: InventoryPosition, Batch, genealogy, custody, title, restriction, reservation and availability authority did not exist; Auction exclusivity alone could not protect the same physical grain across lots.

findings.finding: W2-B removes the false verified-source assumption from the new Auction registration edge: the inventory-bound lot remains DECLARED, can be PUBLIC_ALLOWED, keeps source_verified_at null and does not fabricate independent verification. Complete fact-level trust axes, evidence freshness/conflicts and immutable TradeRiskAcknowledgement are still absent.
findings.requiredDelta: Extend the accepted separation into canonical Deal and later Offer/RFQ paths; persist EXISTENCE/QUANTITY/QUALITY/LOCATION/CUSTODY/OWNERSHIP/REGULATORY facts with provenance/freshness/conflict state and immutable disclosure/acceptance evidence.
findings.w0Finding: Trust was binary or opaque and caller source labels could be stamped verified; DECLARED plus PUBLIC_ALLOWED and immutable risk acknowledgement were unavailable.

findings.area: Two-sided market, RFQ, offers and negotiation
findings.finding: The PostgreSQL auction supply path is strong and new Auction lots are now inventory-bound. DemandRequest, RFQ, OfferVersion, CounterOffer, Negotiation, MatchCandidate and DealDraft are absent; search projects only tombstoned legacy lots. Deal creation still accepts only an auction basis.
findings.requiredDelta: Keep Auction and canonical Deal; add two-sided market aggregates and generic immutable DealBasis adapters after the current Auction-to-Deal inventory allocation boundary is closed.

findings.finding: Exact Money and measure objects exist and a partial calculator exists, but it is explicitly disconnected from live money and accepts unversioned defaults and legacy numeric shapes.
findings.requiredDelta: Create source-backed, versioned seller netback and buyer landed-cost projections from accepted terms and commercial rules.

findings.finding: Legacy lots openly lack PostgreSQL locking, reservations, tenant isolation and audit. Production mutations are tombstoned, but public routes remain mounted.
findings.requiredDelta: Keep a fail-closed compatibility tombstone until clients migrate; never revive this service as authority.

findings.finding: Deal, participants, events, passport, RLS and atomic audit/outbox are reusable. PrismaDealRepository consumes the confirmed Auction DEAL_BASIS_READY event, but it does not yet allocate the winning quantity against the immutable Auction inventory binding; creation remains Auction-only and starts the Deal at DRAFT.
findings.requiredDelta: Reuse the same PrismaDealRepository and Auction award in one atomic W2-C transaction that persists exact stock allocation and award binding without changing the canonical commercial basis/saga shape; then add other origin/basis adapters and correct lifecycle semantics without DealV2.

findings.finding: Immutable signed ContractVersion and supersession chains exist, but application command APIs are incomplete and legal templates plus GrainFlow commercial terms are hard-coded and caller-rendered.
findings.requiredDelta: Add approved templates, clauses, DealConstitution and SpecificationVersion derived only from agreed Deal terms.

findings.finding: DealDocument has immutable versions, verified storage, signature evidence, fingerprints, RLS, audit and outbox. The type matrix and lifecycle are incomplete and DealDocument can diverge from AccountingDocument.
findings.requiredDelta: Unify authoritative document requirements and extend lifecycle types without weakening immutability.

findings.finding: SigningAuthority and a deny-by-default MFA/certificate/MChD policy exist, but the policy is not wired into the production signature writer and MChD is not validated against a live revocation source. External EDO/signature methods correctly fail as not activated.
findings.requiredDelta: Wire the policy atomically, implement provider-neutral ports and receipts, then obtain provider contracts, credentials and revocation feeds.

findings.finding: The PostgreSQL lab sample, custody, test and signed protocol authority is strong. Provision/admission is not exposed through API, no generalized verification order exists and a FAILED result still advances Deal to QUALITY_ACCEPTED.
findings.requiredDelta: Expose safe admission, add generalized verification orchestration and explicit reject, retest and adjustment branches.

findings.finding: Shipment, checkpoints, GPS, PIN and admission are durable. A Deal gets one deterministic shipment; assignment is immutable; request, quote, provider/own-fleet selection, split shipment and correction flows are missing. Live driver UI simulates synchronization instead of using the real queue library.
findings.requiredDelta: Extend the same shipment authority with marketplace, multi-shipment and correction events and connect the durable offline queue.

findings.finding: Production-mounted elevator routes store acts in a process-local Map, use Float, trust caller elevatorOrgId, lack tenant/deal authorization and suppress audit failures.
findings.requiredDelta: Fail-close unsafe mutations, then add PostgreSQL facility, intake, weighing correction, custody, capacity and storage-position authority.

findings.finding: Forecast crop types and ForwardDeal are absent. Insurance is hard-coded partner copy and fictional provider data, with no offer, policy, coverage, claim or payout lifecycle.
findings.requiredDelta: Separate forecast from physical availability and build provider-neutral insurance lifecycle before live provider onboarding.

findings.finding: Bank-neutral settlement, holds, callback keys and pending bank operations exist. No outbound bank consumer, complete bank adapter, BillingPort, FinancingPort, bank binding or live finality receipt exists. The named live adapter is a skeleton.
findings.requiredDelta: Add bank-neutral plans and ports first; Sber contracts, OAuth/mTLS, callbacks and acceptance remain external blockers.

findings.finding: ATI board, auction, order, webhook, tracking and organization-binding adapters are absent.
findings.requiredDelta: Implement ports and conformance tests up to the credential boundary; obtain ATI contract, documentation and credentials separately.

findings.finding: Provider-neutral skeletons exist, EPD is disabled, and two production webhooks are not acceptable evidence: one is unsigned and non-persistent; the other has optional timestamp, process-local replay protection and no state update.
findings.requiredDelta: Remove unsigned bypasses, persist raw-body verified receipts and add provider contracts and credentials after internal conformance.

findings.finding: FGIS inbox, correlation, retries and quarantine are the strongest external contour and correctly remain non-live. The generic gateway is incomplete; applicability lacks the full matrix and reporting logs SUCCESS for a shell without a durable submission receipt.
findings.requiredDelta: Preserve the inbox pattern, add applicability/obligation/submission/receipt/correction aggregates and never report external success without receipt.

findings.finding: Connection Center honestly reports adapterImplemented false. Only a transport contract and test fake exist; mapping, synchronization, conflicts and receipts are absent.
findings.requiredDelta: Implement canonical mappings and conflict/reconciliation workflow before credentialed 1C acceptance.

findings.area: Accounting, financial obligations and settlement plan
findings.finding: Settlement and accounting hold strong exact payment, allocation, beneficiary, reconciliation and hash-chain facts. There is no unified obligation ledger or explicit multi-scheme SettlementPlan. Two legacy ledger implementations remain memory/global-account based.
findings.requiredDelta: Extend settlement/accounting into one obligation view and plan router; retire competing ledger mutation authorities.

findings.finding: Bank account registry, platform receivable/payable, revenue recognition, partner accrual, payment authority matrix and 13-week forecast are absent.
findings.requiredDelta: Build treasury as a separate accounting projection over canonical obligations and receipts, not as another wallet ledger.

findings.finding: Canonical cases, participants, append-only evidence, appeals, money instructions, receipts, RLS, CAS and idempotency exist. Response, counter-evidence, retest, survey, expert review and proven partial holds remain incomplete.
findings.requiredDelta: Extend the same dispute authority with claims and partial-resolution branches.

findings.finding: Append-only eligibility evidence is reusable. Anti-fraud transition state is process-local, ranking is opaque, and reputation can fabricate fallback metrics when persistence is unavailable.
findings.requiredDelta: Create durable evidence graph, RiskCase and transparent versioned decision factors; fail closed instead of inventing scores.

findings.finding: The web boundary reads and acknowledges server events, but the server inbox and read state are process-local and templates are hard-coded.
findings.requiredDelta: Add PostgreSQL inbox, outbox-driven delivery, attempts, receipts, preferences, quiet hours and mandatory exceptions.

findings.finding: Individual deadlines and audit before/after facts exist, but no durable business calendar, pause/resume/escalation engine or governed ExceptionCase/manual-resolution workflow exists.
findings.requiredDelta: Implement server-authoritative deadlines and two-person exception resolution without fabricating external finality.

findings.area: Entitlements, organization lifecycle, moderation and data governance
findings.finding: Membership invitation, revoke and security controls are reusable. Platform entitlements, full organization lifecycle, marketplace moderation and durable privacy governance are absent; the privacy portal is hard-coded and local-only.
findings.requiredDelta: Add server-backed governance registries and remove unsupported privacy and processor claims.

findings.finding: The protected shell replaces real role pages with a generic RoleIntentDashboard and an empty message with no activation call to action. Tests currently preserve the contradictory behavior.
findings.requiredDelta: Show capability-specific first actions and the real role workspace to ordinary authenticated users.

findings.finding: Useful next-action, human-copy and progressive-disclosure patterns exist, but the production Deal 360 route reads static canonical fixtures and sandbox logistics/incidents. Thousands of inline styles remain outside the design system.
findings.requiredDelta: Keep the composition and tokens; replace every static authority with server-backed read models and complete role-specific information architecture.

findings.area: Search, screen states, confirmations, forms, tables and saved views
findings.finding: The command palette searches navigation only; durable domain search, saved searches, alerts and saved views are absent. Good isolated loading/error/form patterns exist, but no mandatory all-screen contract or industrial grid and irreversible actions lack a unified confirmation ceremony.
findings.requiredDelta: Build server-backed discovery and reusable state, form, table, diff and confirmation contracts.

findings.finding: Public and generic shell coverage is substantial, but private role tests exercise the generic dashboard and full WCAG 2.2 AA automation runs only on a subset of critical surfaces.
findings.requiredDelta: Prove every real private critical flow at 320, 390, 430, tablet and desktop with keyboard, reduced-motion and AA checks.

findings.finding: There is no settings subtree, scope inheritance or effective-value provenance. Team and connector diagnostics are partial foundations. Most personal, role, integration, finance, signature, Gekta, privacy and developer settings are absent; API keys and webhooks are process-local.
findings.requiredDelta: Build settings as a server-authoritative platform after the underlying configuration models exist.

findings.finding: The assistant is explicitly informational/read-only and has useful role/deal context. It is not embedded in every key workflow and contract/integration explanations and settings remain incomplete.
findings.requiredDelta: Keep the no-irreversible-authority boundary and extend read/prepared-action context only after domain authorities exist.

findings.finding: Executive aggregation and public SEO/i18n/mobile foundations exist. Unit economics and ClickHouse panels are demo/static, and seller, buyer and partner analytics are incomplete.
findings.requiredDelta: Replace demo analytics with source-backed metrics and remove unsupported public claims.

findings.finding: SDK and API use incompatible environment names, default to stub, startup permits mocks, config validation has no runtime caller and readiness checks only database/migrations rather than outbox and provider degradation.
findings.requiredDelta: Unify and validate fail-closed modes at startup and publish machine-readable provider and queue readiness without calling mocks live.

findings.finding: OTEL, Prometheus, Sentry and queue/reconciliation telemetry exist, but alert expressions and labels do not match emitted runtime metrics.
findings.requiredDelta: Bind every alert to emitted exact metric names and prove firing/recovery in acceptance.

findings.finding: Durable workers, retry/DLQ, HPA and PDB exist, but post-registration RPO/RTO, PITR, backup evidence and exact-release restore/DR drills are not proven.
findings.requiredDelta: Set approved RPO/RTO and attach real REG.RU backup, restore and DR drill evidence to an exact revision.

findings.finding: RLS, MFA/JIT, bank callback keys and immutable ledgers are strong. Public EDO webhook verification, replay persistence, TLS claims, mock configuration and external egress rules remain unsafe or contradictory.
findings.requiredDelta: Close unsigned webhooks, require secure transports, persist replay state, align egress with approved providers and re-run threat/negative tests.

findings.finding: No evidence shows 5 to 8 unaided tasks completed by real users for each role. Current role roots prevent the required first primary action without support.
findings.requiredDelta: Run role-based research only after server-backed workflows replace generic and demo surfaces.
